title: Change
description: One entity-level difference between the before and the after sheet (docs/contracts/r1.md §3 `change`, sidecar `changes[]` in docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §7). Ids are deterministic (`ch<seq>`), so the same inputs and the same `run_date` always produce byte-identical `clusters.json`; the database ULID is never written to the file. A change that the rules fold as `minor` still gets a record -- it is what the review screen shows when 사소한 변경 보기 is switched on -- but it is not clustered and draws no cloud mark.

seq.description: 1-based position of the change within its pair, in the comparison's own deterministic order. `id` is `"ch" + seq`.

etype.description: DXF record name of the entity the change is about (`LINE`, `INSERT`, `MTEXT`, ...). For `blockdef` it is `INSERT`, since that is what is drawn.

layer.description: Layer of the entity in its own drawing (the after layer when there is an after side, otherwise the before layer). Kept in XDATA as `orig_layer` on the compare DXF entity.

before_handle.description: Handle in the before working DXF. Null for `added`.

after_handle.description: Handle in the after working DXF. Null for `removed`.

bbox.description: Extent of the change in the after sheet's world coordinates (mm). For `moved` it is the union of the before and the after position (docs/contracts/compare-dxf.md §5).

minor.description: True when the change was folded by the `compare.yaml` `minor` rules: a move of at most `move_tolerance` mm, or one of the structural fold reasons. Minor changes are excluded from clusters, cloud marks and the revision table.

cluster_id.description: Cluster this change was grouped into, `c<number>` (`compare/cluster.schema.json` `$defs.cluster_id` owns the form; it is spelled out here rather than referenced so the two files stay a one-way dependency -- `cluster` refers to `change`, never back). Null for a minor change and for a change that no cloud mark covers.

compare_handles.description: Handles this change occupies inside the compare DXF, so the viewer's hit test can reach the change record. Filled in by `compare/compare_dxf.py` after the file is written.

added.description: Entities written to `__CMP_ADDED` for this change.

removed.description: Entities written to `__CMP_REMOVED` for this change.

change_id.title: ChangeId
change_id.description: `ch<seq>` -- deterministic within one pair, so `clusters.json` diffs cleanly between runs.

change_kind.title: ChangeKind
change_kind.description: `added` only in the after sheet, `removed` only in the before sheet, `modified` same entity with different geometry or properties, `moved` same entity translated, `text` string content differs, `dimension` a dimension's measurement or text differs, `blockdef` the block definition behind an unchanged INSERT differs (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

minor_reason.title: MinorReason
minor_reason.description: Why the change was folded as minor, or null when it was not folded. Several reasons are joined with `+` in the order they are listed here: `move_le_0_01` a translation of at most `compare.yaml` `minor.move_tolerance` mm, `layer_only`/`color_only`/`linetype_only`/`lineweight_only` a property change with identical geometry, `hatch_regen` a hatch re-generated with the same boundary, `dim_regen` a dimension re-generated with the same measurement, `mtext_format_only` MTEXT whose plain text is unchanged (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).
minor_reason.$comment: `null` is part of the type rather than an `anyOf` branch at the two use sites, so datamodel-code-generator collapses the reference to `str | None` instead of wrapping it in a RootModel that would never compare equal to a plain string.

delta.title: ChangeDelta
delta.description: What actually differs, in a shape that depends on `kind`. `move` and `distance` are pinned here because the auto label and the review list read them directly; everything else is filled in per kind by the compare engine (R1-06) and is deliberately left open. Null when the kind carries no measurable delta (`added`, `removed`).
delta.$comment: The one open object in the compare contract. `additionalProperties: true` is deliberate (brief R1-01, Defaults for ambiguity): pinning every per-kind payload now would force a schema change with every rule the diff engine grows.

move.description: Translation `[dx, dy]` in millimetres, rounded to 3 decimals.

distance.description: Length of `move` in millimetres, rounded to 6 decimals. What the auto label prints as `이동 1,250mm`.

change_provenance.title: ChangeProvenance
change_provenance.description: Where the two sides of the change came from (CLAUDE.md rule 5). `before` is absent for `added`, `after` for `removed`; at least one side is always present.
